messages.content: What's going on today?
My lower back has been hurting since I lifted something heavy.
What do you do for work?
How are you doing today, ma'am?
I'm doing just fine.
Any kind of alcohol consumption?
Nope.
Have you ever taken any kind of illegal drugs?
Nope.
What about smoking?
No.
Are you still working?
What can I help you with today?
I feel really tired all the time lately.
Has it been getting better, worse, or staying about the same?
It's been getting worse.
Have you had any tests done for this before?
I had an X-ray last year, but nothing since.
How has your hygiene routine been given your symptoms?
Are you from the area?
No. I was born and raised in North Carolina. I am the sixth of nine siblings.
What is your medical history involving your parents?

My dad died due to complications of his diabetes. He passed when he was sixty. My dad was a chef. My mom is doing well. She is ninety three. Both my parents never finished high school. My dad had a third grade education and my mom made it through fourth grade. She was a janitor. She was a smart woman she just never finished her schooling. My parents encouraged me to finish school and to go to college. I got my Bachelor of Science in Nursing at the State University in nineteen seventy nine.
Did you have any problems in school such as learning disabilities or attentional problems?
No, neither.
Did you have any problems in school such as difficulty learning to read or failed grades?
Yes, I've had failed grades, but not difficulty learning to read.
Did you have any problems in school such as special help in school or behavioral problems?
No. I mostly got A's and B's. My strongest subject was math, but my worst subject was spelling. My grades were still quite good in spelling, but I had to work hard at it.
Are you married?

I was married for two years. We had two children together. They are forty three and thirty now. My son is the youngest, lives nearby and calls me or stops by every day. My daughter calls me often but she lives in New York. We are close. Their dad, my exhusband passed away in nineteen eighty. He was an alcoholic. His pancreas had enough and shut down.
Are you working in health care with your nursing degree?

I worked for Hospital Center for four years. Prior to that, I worked for an outpatient mental health center. I was there for about two and a years. I was fired or laid off I guess? I was not sure why they let me go. I was given no explanation. And before that, I worked for Walter P. Carter Center for twenty one years. I also worked as an O B nurse. Other than the two instances, I had never been fired or let go from a job.
What do you like to do in your spare time?
What seems to be the problem?
Well‚ I am having a hard time. My whole body aches and I am in pain.
Do you have a history of drug use?
Well yes. I am detoxing.
What kind of drugs have you been using?
Heroin.
How long have you been using?
I don't feel well. Maybe a year. I can't sleep or eat.
Have you had a fever, chills, vomiting or diarrhea?
How are you feeling?
I've been having a lot more joint pain lately.
You're seventy seven, correct?
Don't remind me.
When did you first start experiencing joint pain?
Couple years ago.
In what ways has it worsened?
It's caused me to become less active in general. My hands and wrists aren't as mobile.
Have you noticed any increased swelling?
No, but it's all gotten to be a little too uncomfortable.
Is that helping?
No.
And no redness to the area, right?
No.
Fever or chills?
I had diarrhea for a few days, but it's gotten much better. I was also having trouble holding my bladder.
Are you going to the bathroom more often, experiencing excessive thirst, or other problems?
No. My incontinence is a bit better and so is my ankle and foot swelling.
How has your blood sugar been?
A little better.
Have you checked your blood pressure recently?
Not recently.
Have you started any new medications?
How are you doing today?
I feel out of it.
Have you been using any substances?
I did a little heroin and some coke earlier today. I still feel high.
Any shortness of breath or chest pain?
No, neither.
Any abdominal pain or back pain?
No.
Are you having any headaches or hallucinations?
No, neither.
Are you having any visual disturbances?
No.
Do you have any open sores or wounds?
So, are you married, ma'am?
Well, no I'm not. My husband and I got a divorce.
I'm sorry to hear that, do you have any children?
It's okay, it was for the best. Yes, I have two.
Do you live with either of them?
Yeah, um, I live with my son right now.
Do you smoke or drink?
You had a heart procedure done couple months back right?
Yes, they had to do a cardioversion on me because of my heart rhythm disorder.
Do you know other medications you are on?
Yes, I have a list with me. Here, look.
Do you have diabetes?
No, I do not.
have you smoked in the past?
Yes, I have, but I quit some years back.
Have you ever had lung problems?
No, I have not.
How about your family?
How can I help you today?
I've noticed some swelling in my ankles.
Do you have any other ongoing medical conditions I should know about?
I have high blood pressure.
Does anything make it better or worse?
How can I help you today?
I've had this stomach pain since yesterday.
Have you had any nausea or vomiting?
Yes, I've thrown up twice.
Have you had any fever or chills?
So, remind me, how long ago was your procedure?
Let me think. Now, it's been about four months. I just turned fifty nine.
Yep, and where are you living now?
Thankfully, I left the nursing home, and I'm back in my own house now.
Are you in any pain today?
No, not today.
have you been going to P T?
Yeah, I've been going about two or three times a week.
Are there any signs of infection, like drainage from the incision?
Nope, the wound healed up nicely. I'll be able to wear shorts again.
are you having any fever symptoms, like cough, runny nose, sore throat, fatigue, anything like that?
Are you a smoker?
Yes.
Do you use alcohol or any recreational drugs?
I have been in treatment for heroin and alcohol in the past.
Any current use of drugs or alcohol?
What brings you in today?
My throat has been sore and it hurts to swallow.
Do you have any other ongoing medical conditions I should know about?
How are you feeling today?
Thank you. I am doing better.
How is your physical therapy going?
It is going really well. She kicks my butt but it seems to be helping. Doing my exercises at home is really helping.
Were you not doing them in the beginning?
No, I wasn't. She got on me to start doing them and I have definitely seen the difference.
Have you experienced any worsening of pain since you were last seen?
Well, the right knee is worse than the left? It mostly hurts after physical therapy.
Can you describe what the pain feels like?
It feels achy.
Is it a continuous pain, or?
No. It is not all the time. Every once and a while. It feels stiff all the time.
Any weakness or instability?
No.
Any burning sensations associated with the pain?
No.
How long have you been dealing with this?
Several months.
Have you had any trouble sleeping?
No. When I sit down or lie down at night there's no pain.
So, the pain is when you are weight bearing, right?
Yeah. And it hurts when I move around. It makes it difficult to do things.
Have you noticed any pain with the cold weather change?
No, I have not noticed anything.
Have you noticed any of these symptoms?
Nope.
Any radiating pain through the knees here?
No.
Any pain any where else in the body?
No, just the knees.
Are you having any pain in your hips or back?
Any fever?
No.
No nausea and vomiting or black stool?
Nope, nothing like that.
Did you notice any blood in urine or painful urination?
No.
any chest pain?
Um, no.
Any shortness of breath, cough or cold like symptoms?
Nope.
Do you have diabetes or a thyroid problem?
How are you doing today?
I'm doing well, no headaches, and I'm breastfeeding well.
Have you had any bleeding?
Nope, none.
Are you using a mini pad?
Yeah, I use it twice a day.
Do you have any cramping or clotting?
No, thankfully I don't.
What color is your discharge, ma'am?
Well, its turned from red to brown, and now its kind of yellowish.
have you had sex again yet?
No, we're waiting a little longer.
Are you going to the bathroom regularly?
Regularly? Yes, but I'm having some pain with it, and then every once in a while I have some bright red bleeding.
Are you constipated?
No, I'm not. She hasn't been eating her vegetables like she should.
What symptoms do you have with your allergies?
What's going on today?
I feel really tired all the time lately.
Have you had any fever or night sweats?
No, neither.
Have you had any changes in your appetite?
Yes, I haven't felt like eating much.
Have you noticed any swelling in your neck or anywhere else?
What is the reason for your visit today?
I was referred by a doctor to come see you so that you could check up on my nasal problems. Here is my report from my previous doctor who referred me to you.
here it says you had severe sinusitis two to three months ago, correct?
Is that what they're calling my nasal problems?
Would you be able to describe to me what you had been feeling two to three months ago?
Yeah, I can. My face would feel uncomfortable, my nose was stuffy, my eyes hurt, and I felt something dropping in the back of my throat.
Have you ever been prescribed any medication?
Here's the list of medicine I was taking.
you were given antibiotics, correct?
I was, but I don't know what those are. Could you explain them to me?
Do you remember if the antibiotics helped?
Not really. I felt like my symptoms were the same.
Did your doctor order any advanced imaging's?
Yeah. They did a C T scan of my nose. Here is the report from my C T scan.
Going back to your list of medications, I know you took antibiotics for your infection, but did you take any medication for your sinuses?
No, I haven't. I did try this cream for my nose, but that didn't work either. Nothing worked!
Are there any other symptoms that you have been experiencing?

I've had some trouble with my balance, and I feel like I've lost some of my hearing. I thought this was odd since I'm only fifty years old. I think my ears felt plugged or full of air, so they just needed to pop.
Do you feel any fullness or pressure?
No, I don't feel anything like that right now.
Do you hear any humming or buzzing?
No, neither.
Do you hear any roaring sounds?
Nope. I don't hear anything like that.
When did you start noticing your balance was affected?
I think it could have been to this one medicine that starts with an A. I forgot the name, but it didn't really help my nasal problems. It just made my balance worse.
Was the medicine called Allegra?
Oh, yeah. That's what it was called. I thought I had some sort of allergy, so I thought it would help.
Did you ever feel any dizziness too?
So, I see you Were you diagnosed with an acid reflux problem and high blood pressure twenty years back?
Yes.
Also, you had a brain stroke?
Yes, mini stroke!
And currently are you on any medications?
What brings you in today?
Yeah. I am forty five. I've had really bad stomach pain on my right side since last week.
On a scale of one to ten, how bad is the pain at its worst?
I'd have to say a seven.
How would you rate it now?
Oh um it's at a five at the moment.
Have you been taking your diabetes medication?
What brings you in today?
My throat has been sore and it hurts to swallow.
Do you smoke or use any tobacco products?
No, I've never smoked.
Do you use any recreational drugs?
I smoke marijuana occasionally.
Who do you live with at home?
How're you today?
Not too bad. I'm hanging in there. My asthma has been acting up.
How long has this been going on?
For the past three months. I've been using my inhaler every day. I used to use it every now and again. This is definitely new for me.
Are you experiencing any allergies alongside your asthma?
Yes, actually. My husband has been hauling a lot more corn this season and it seems to be making my allergies much worse.
Do you take anything for your allergies?
Not really. I'll sometimes take Allegra and that seems to help just a tiny bit. I was previously prescribed Flonase, but I can't remember the last time I took it. Oh and I was on Advair, too.
Did the Flonase or Advair help at all?
I had to stop Advair because it started to bother my lady parts.
How so?
I noticed that it became more itchy as a result.
Do you notice these symptoms are still there after you finish your cycle?
Um lemme think. The symptoms start about a week before my period and tend to get less intense once I get over the first day of bleeding.
Are your cycles generally regular?
For the most part, yes. I feel like they don't last as long as they used to. I'm not sure why. I do, however, notice some spotting after my cycles end.
Do you get any night sweats or hot flashes while you're on your period?
No.
Have you had any other medical troubles recently?
I did have a U T I and some blood in my urine because of it.
Do you remember how many times you noticed blood in your urine?
Hm about three times. I was prescribed antibiotics for it.
Have you had any other urinary symptoms since?
Nothing now.
Have you gotten your urine rechecked recently?
No, not yet. I really should get it checked out again.
Do you have a specific urologist that you see?
Yeah, I can call to make the appointment tomorrow. Do I also need to get blood work done?
Do you know what they checked?
I think the typical blood work with cholesterol added.
Do you have a copy of those test results available?
Do you have any history of heart disease that you know of?
Nope, nothing like that.
How about diabetes?
No, there's no sugar here that I know of.
Do you have any history of lung problems?
Do you use tobacco products, alcohol, or recreational drugs, miss?
I have a drink every once and a while.
How many drinks do you consume in a week?
I don't even drink that often. I probably have one drink per month.
Are you married?
I was engaged but that is not happening anymore. It is a long story.
What do you do for work?
Do you have allergies?
Yes ragweed. I am twelve.
So basically, you are just congested?
Yes that's right. The last ten days.
Any headache?
Yes I had a little yesterday. Clear boogers.
You feel hot?
No.
Anyone sick at home?
Have you experienced any headaches or blackouts recently?
No.
Dizziness or seizure?
Nope.
Any history of stroke?
Do you have allergies to any medications?
Um I'm allergic to Clonidine and Medifast.
What happens when you take Clonidine?
I get a really bad rash.
How have you been doing with the Medifast diet?
So what seems to be the problem today?
I've been having really bad headaches lately.
Have you had any blurry vision or light sensitivity?
Yes, I've had blurry vision.
Have you had any nausea or vomiting with it?
You are back for a follow up on your right arm pain, right?
Yes. It has been almost a year since the pain first started.
How has your arm been feeling?
I still have this dull pain in my upper outer area of my arm.
How long does the pain last?
It was coming and going, but now the pain is more persistent since I last saw you. It is still happening every day. Yeah. It makes is hard to do things with the persistent pain.
Are you experiencing any numbness or tingling sensation in your arm?
Yes, I've had tingling sensation in your arm, but not numbness.
Are you experiencing any hand?
No, but I have had this achy sensation in my hand radiating down to my fingers.
Do you have a history of any other neck or shoulder injuries?
It is not from a specific injury but I have had this neck pain for thirty years.
Did you see anyone for the neck pain?

Yes. I saw someone for it in two thousand and six, and then I developed this ear pain. They could not figure out what was going on so eventually I was sent to have an M R I of my neck and upper spine, which showed some degenerative changes. Then I was referred to Doctor X who was treating me for neck pain. He gave me steroid injections.
Are you still seeing Doctor X for the epidural injections?
Yes. I have been seeing him since two thousand and seven.
How old are you?
I am fifty eight.
Are you experiencing any symptoms from receiving the injections?
Those are for neck pain. My arm pain recent. I have been having the injections for a while now, without any trouble.
What medications have you been taking for the pain?
There are a few of them that I take. I gave the list to the nurse.
Does the pain interfere with your daily activities or quality of life?
What brings you in today?
I've had a lot of discomfort in my private area.
When did it start?
It's been going on for about two weeks now.
Have you noticed any abnormal discharge?
Not really, no. But it's been super itchy down there.
Any abdominal pain or nausea?
Yes, I've had abdominal pain, but not nausea.
Any vomiting?
Uh no, but I'm having some pain here.
Near your pelvis?
Yeah.
Have you started any new lotions or products?
No.
Have you tried anything for the pain or itching?
No, not yet. I thought it'd go away on it's own.
Have you been sexually active prior to or after noticing these concerns?
Uh once this past week, but it was pretty painful.
Did you use protection?
Any headaches?
No.
Any history of seizures or epilepsy?
No.
Any sudden loss of consciousness or have you blacked out?
Um, no.
Any weakness?
No, nothing like that.
Any history of stroke or any brain related condition?
Do you smoke or drink alcohol?
No, I do not smoke or drink alcohol.
How about drugs?
Nope, I have never.
Who do you live with?
What seems to be the problem today, sir?
Um, I was peeing blood, it's back again.
Did you do anything that could have provoked it to come back?
No, not that I know of.
Have you been taking the Flomax for your B P H?
Yes, I have been.
What about the Coumadin?
Yes, I've been taking that too. It has been held recently, but I ususally take it.
What conditions have you been taking the Coumadin for?
I have A F I B and stroke.
Isn't this your second occurrence of gross hematuria this month?
Yes, doctor.
Are you sure you haven't experienced any falls or anything recently?
Yeah, actually I fell about a week ago.
Where is your pain from that fall?
It's in my butt and leg.
Have you had your x rays taken yet?
Yeah, the x ray tech just brought me back.
When is your pain worst?
My chart here says that you're eighty three years old, is that correct, ma'am?
Yes doctor, that's correct, I just had my birthday.
How have you been doing since your last visit?
Well, my cancer hasn't needed phlebotomies for several months now, which is good.
you have been treated for polycythemia vera, correct?
so you're sixty seven years old, and White, correct?
Yes, that's right doctor.
Do you remember how many cycles of carboplatin and Taxol you've had for your cancer, ma'am?
Um, I've had six, I'm here for a follow up today.
do you have any problems today?
Well, I just have some numbness in my right upper arm today.
Has this gotten worse recently?
Well, no, not really.
Do you feel this in your toes at all?
No, there's no numbness there.
do you have any tingling or burning to speak of?
Can you tell me what are the diseases you have been diagnosed with in the past?
I have had hypertension, diabetes, asthma and cholesterol problem.
is there anything else?
Nope.
Is it type 2 diabetes?
Do you smoke or drink, ma'am?
I don't smoke, and I drink, um, I'd say on occasionally.
What about harder drugs, do you use any of those?
No, I don't.
Are you married?
Yes, to my wonderful husband.
what do you two do for a living?
I'm a social worker, and my husband is a high school chemistry teacher.
What kinds of people do you work with as a social worker?
I love it, I work with adult abuse and neglect issues.
Do you have any children?
Yes, we have two sons.
Do they live at home?
Hi, how are you doing?
I'm good. Thank you.
How old are you, young lady?
Eighty four.
What brings you here?
I had a fall. And I was told to consult you for my heart conditions.
Um?
Yeah, I have high blood pressure. And they also diagnosed me with other heart diseases. I cannot pronounce all the names I don't remember.
In simple words, just to check if there are any irregularities in your heart beating, okay?
Hm, okay.
So tell me what happened?
I'm not sure about how it happened, but yeah, I fell yesterday on my driveway and kind of hit a rock.
Which side did you hit the rock?
Um I think it was left side.
What happened in the emergency room?
They gave me some medicine. And they put something on my finger. They said that my heart rate was very high.
How was your heart feeling when you fell yesterday?
I felt that I just ran in a race. I could feel all the pain after that fall. It was ugly. My heart was pounding so fast it was ready to come out, I never felt like that before in my life.
Did you feel the same way afterwards as well?
No, it was just after fall. It did not stay like that for long, I was normal later. I never felt it again after that incident.
Do you have any pain or discomfort in your chest?
I don't think so.
How about before the fall?
Nope.
Are you having any shortness of breath?
Is this your mother?
Good afternoon, doctor. Yes, this is my mom.
What do you mean, bad crowd?
Well, I got addicted to drugs out there, and I used to inject heroin.
Did you see a doctor for this addiction?
Yeah, I saw another doctor in the city.
How did they treat you at that time?
They prescribed me methadone for a while.
Did that help at all?
Honestly, no, it didn't help at all.
Do you remember the dosage that you were given?
Um, it was ten M G.
How long did you take methadone for?
Um, it was for three or four months.
Did you ever try to decrease your dosage?
Yeah, um, I tried to wean off it for a while, but I was never really successful.
Have you been using heroin since?
Um, yeah, I've been using it occasionally.
Were you roommates at school using drugs?
Yeah, so it's hard to get away from the stuff, it was all over the house. Well, he can now, especially because he lives with me.
when was the last time you used heroin?
Um, it's been about eight days now.
When was the last time you had methadone?
Um, it's been about a week for that now, too. Am I able to get more today?
Have you had any feelings of depression recently?
Yeah, I feel down and sad a lot.
What about your energy?
I really don't have much.
What about your enthusiasm for the foods or activities you enjoy?
He hasn't had much enthusiasm for anything, either.
Are you having any suicidal or homicidal thoughts?
No, neither.
Are you having any actions at this time?
No, nothing like that, doctor.
what about delusions, hallucinations, or disorganized thoughts or behaviors?
No, nothing like that either, doctor.
Do you have any medical conditions in the past that I should know about?
No, not that I know of. No, he hasn't been treated for anything before, doctor.
You completed your family and social history earlier with the nurses, is there anything you want to add to that?
No, everything there is complete.
Do you have any allergies?
No, I don't have any.
and do you take any medications right now?
No, doctor. I don't take anything.
Have you had any surgeries in the past?
What's going on today?
I've noticed some blood in my urine the last couple days.
Have you had any pain or burning with urination?
Yes, it burns a little.
Have you had any fever or back pain?
No, neither.
Have you noticed any blood clots or changes in your urine color?
No.
Have you noticed any increase in how often you need to urinate?
With ten being the worst pain imaginable, how would you rate your pain today out of ten, ma'am?
Well, out of ten, I'd say it's about a seven.
How would you describe your pain?
Um, I'd say it's deep, and it really aches.
Where is your pain located?
It's in my right lower back, and then into my butt.
What activities make your surgery worse?
I can't go up and down stairs without a lot of pain, and it hurts when I sit for a long time, like when I drive.
Before this pain, how would you describe your activity level?
I was very active before all this started.
Are you able to do any of your prior activities?
What can I help you with today?
I've noticed I'm losing weight without trying.
How much physical activity do you usually get in a week?
Not much, I have a pretty sedentary job.
How has your sleep been lately?
I've had trouble falling asleep.
Do you have any other ongoing medical conditions I should know about?
How's she doing?
She's had better days.
Aw and why's that?

She's been really congested recently. Snorting a lot more, too. She's onlt eleven and I think it is odd she snores so much. I took her to see the allergist and he said it's not her allergies so we stopped giving her Allegra.
Does she happen to snore at night?
No, not really.
Have you applied anything to the area?
Hi Ryan, what brings you here today?
Well, you told me to follow up if my cough doesn't get better. Also, I started having several other issues.
so tell me about your cough, is it getting worse than before?
It's about the same but not getting better.
And what about your diarrhea and stomach pain?
No more diarrhea and no pian.
Bowel movement?
Normal.
Any pain while peeing?
No pain and no problem emptying my bladder.
Any nausea or vomiting?
Nope, but I have developed this weird sore taste in my mouth.
How long?
Since last week.
Any loss of appetite?
No, not really.
and what other issues were you talking about?
Yeah, I am also having some trouble with my eyes, I am able see fine, but it feels kind of funny.
Did you injure it or had a fall or anything?
Are you married?
Yes, for almost twenty two years now.
And are you working?
Ah yes, I drive a delivery truck in the town.
So, tell me do you smoke or drink? And how much would you say you smoke per day?
I smoke about two packs a day.
how much do you drink?
I drink three, oh wait, I drink two beers every day.
And do you do any drugs like coke or anything?
Do you use tobacco products?
Yes. I smoke cigarettes. I am working on quitting.
How much do you smoke per day now?
I smoke about a pack a day.
Do you drink alcohol or use recreational drugs?
I drink but I don't do any drugs.
How many alcoholic drinks do you consume per week?
I drink about four drinks per night. I used to drink a lot more than that. I have cut back on my drinking.
Are you physically active?
I was very athletic when I was growing up. Now I don't exercise on a regular basis.
What do you do for employment?
I am a network engineer. I work for Shepherd Pratt.
Are you married?
Yes. I have been married to my wife for five years now.
Do you live at home with your wife and or is there anyone else living in your home?
Any fever or chills?
No, neither.
Any rigors?
No.
Any blurring of vision or history of glaucoma?
No, neither.
Any cataract?
No.
Did you experience any shortness of breath?
No.
Any stomach discomfort?
No.
Did you observe blood in your stool or in vomit?
No, nothing like that.
Did you notice any increase in your urine frequency or urgency?
No.
Do you feel any muscle weakness or tiredness?
No, nothing of that sort.
Any known history of arthritis?
Nope.
And no fever due to any fungal infection or anything?
No, neither.
And no fever due to any right?
No, nothing of that sort.
Any history of pneumonia?
No.
No thyroid or hormone related problem?
No.
Do you have any history of blood disorders?
So how are you feeling?
I am feeling well.
Any illness or fever?
No, nothing like that.
Any headache or nausea?
No.
Any vomiting or stomach upset?
No.
any numbness tingling or loss of sensation in the hand?
No, not at all.
Are you otherwise feeling well?
Where are you from?
I am from Denmark. I speak Danish as my first language. Me and my husband have been in the States for many many years. When we first got here, we did not speak a word of English.
How old are you?
I just turned seventy four last month.
How do you know that you have been walking funny?
My husband noticed that I have been walking funny. He noticed it about over six months ago or so.
What do you notice about the way your wife's walk that has changed?

She walks wider then she used to, and I noticed that she stooped over. She walks much slower than she did before. She is often losing her balance. I have noticed her touching the walls and furniture to stabilize herself.
Have you noticed her stabilizing herself all of a sudden?
No. It has been happening more and more over the last six months or so.
What else have you noticed about the way she walks?
I noticed that she is having trouble stepping up onto things like a scale. She seems very unbalanced. She also seems to take her time as she walks. She can't be hurried.
Do you use any devices to assist you to get around?
No. I must help her get in and out of the car. Not every time but sometimes. I am very concerned because she has been falling more and more recently. I have had one emergency room visit.
What happened that you had to go to the emergency room?
I fell. I was walking to the bedroom. I lost my balance so I put my hand out to brace myself against the wall and my hand slipped. I fell on my wrist. She broke her wrist.
